summary: Independent review of the ThinkOrSwim Modified ATR comparison harness. READ-ONLY ANALYSIS; no runtime code, no deploy. THE DESIGN IS RIGHT FOR THE REASON THAT MATTERS: it does NOT assume which shape ThinkOrSwim uses. It builds THREE models and reports all of them — an independent model of our live 04:00 ET reset including its 90-second gap guard, Modified ATR with a 04:00 ET reset and no live-only gap guard, and Modified ATR over continuous history — and states explicitly that chart session settings are part of the input. That is the correct way to locate a divergence point rather than manufacturing agreement. It cites ThinkOrSwim's own WildersAverage reference for the seven-length input prefetch rather than inferring the seed. ⭐ IT DIRECTLY ADDRESSES THE TRAP I FLAGGED: our ATR is SESSION-SLICED at 04:00 ET and atr_oracle is NOT, so a comparison against the wrong internal model diverges for that reason alone and proves nothing. Modelling the sliced and continuous variants side by side is what makes the result interpretable. MUTATION: neutering session_anchor_ms turns 3 controls red, including test_session_sliced_model_resets_at_0400_et_while_continuous... and test_real_live_method_matches_independent_live_model — so both the slice boundary and the agreement between the harness and the real live method are pinned. 16 focused tests on the head I first reviewed, 12 on the rebase. REBASE INTEGRITY: content BYTE-IDENTICAL to what I reviewed — 633 changed lines compared after stripping blob hashes and hunk offsets. Controlled full unit pair vs base 404c694d: base 46 failed / 3710 passed, head 46 failed / 3722 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed. Ancestor PASS. Reviewer differs from the author. ⛔ SCOPE AND STANDING CONSTRAINTS THAT TRAVEL WITH THIS TOOL: (1) The operator has ruled TWICE that we do not ask him for another number or screenshot — this is our program and we prove it from our own bars and our own code. This harness is what makes that possible; do not regress to asking him. (2) ATR IS RECURSIVE, so one matching bar proves the bar and nothing else. The earlier claim that our trail reproduced at 5.4736 was withdrawn for exactly that reason. A result from this tool must state which SERIES, which INITIALISATION and which SESSION TREATMENT it matched before anyone calls the item closed. (3) No heavy historical analysis during market hours. ⚠ METHOD CORRECTION RECORDED: my first controlled-pair run reported 46 new failures on this and both sibling PRs because the base worktree silently failed to create and the comparison ran against an empty baseline. Recomputed against a real base: zero. No findings; nothing withheld.
